scope: Endpoint-aware direct-born electron source above 1000 eV from frozen PR24 1-4 MeV proton injection and neutral H/He SDCS; source only

source.clock: local gas proper second; fixed-bath local ramp, not cosmological propagation
source.angular_measure: angle-integrated source and SDCS; no extra 4*pi

support.endpoint_convention: unchanged nonrelativistic endpoint from pinned Rudd adapter
support.W_panels: split at W_s(1MeV), W_s(4MeV), 10 eV and 1000 eV; both H and He endpoints retained

algorithm: Gauss-Legendre in log K for W-dependent F1/F2 coefficients; log(1+W/I_s) panels for integrated spectrum; independent analytic SDCS moments integrated in K with support breakpoints
PASS_next_action: Independent review then parent-owned local backup/scoped publication; high-energy response needs its own source-backed contract
